title: PendingGuestQuestion
description: A guest's question waiting for the concierge's job (issue #60, ADR 0059): written by the inbound edge, read when the job runs, deleted when it finishes. Keyed by question_id, a hash of the provider's message ref (which has no length limit). Tenant-scoped; the global job index never holds it.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

wedding_id.description: The wedding the guest was bound to when the message came in.

provider_message_ref.description: The provider's opaque handle, as received (dedupe and reconciliation only).

sender_ref.description: The guest's opaque sender handle (the registry binding's key).

body.description: The message, untrusted. Escalated as-is; the model sees a shortened copy as data.
